descriptionHtml:
Decision D12 · P3 · Daniela

The survey says 'Round Companion' while the ticket says 'RoundAI': which name? (split from D9)

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S27 Survey copy as specified: baseline questions and options, Settings feedback text (T6 only)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 Survey questions, answer options and copy are exactly as specified (baseline 6 questions and buckets; handoff follow-up question; … (TFA-94609 AC 1; TFA-94609 Spec 1; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 Spec 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94609 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician (make-session) with the baseline unanswered, so the card shows on the Hospital list

When Open the baseline survey from the card and read every question and option; close it without submitting. Open Settings and read the Feedback section

Then Baseline: the six Spec 1 questions and the bucket options. Feedback: 'How is RoundAI working for you? Your answers go to the pilot team. Please don't include patient details.', a 1-5 rating, 'What should change?', 'Send feedback'. The handoff follow-up question (Spec 2) is checked on screen in S07 and S08

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94609 AC 1 / Spec 1 / Spec 3 (T6, gated: a miss reports as Blocked, which is why it has its own scenario and masks no ungated requirement). Product name: 'Before RoundAI' and 'How is RoundAI working for you?' are knownGaps 'open: Q11' (main shows 'Round Companion', SettingsModal.tsx:285), so the difference shows in the report as a known gap, not as a silent pass

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-94609 ready for qa

The survey copy matches the spec except the product name: the app says 'Round Companion' where TFA-94609 says 'RoundAI' ('Before RoundAI…', 'How is RoundAI working for you?').

Evidence: allure f5280aec-…-result.json; code-review lane, status known-gap. 12/12 Spec 1 / Spec 3 strings are present at e02167f, and B2 and F1 differ only in the name (SettingsModal.tsx:285). The matrix knownGaps mark this 'open: Q11'. T6 is gated on TFA-94609 (ready for pr, PR #86), so a miss would report as Blocked. Note: TFA-94513 AC 2 requires the sign-in screen to say 'Round Companion' (not 'RoundAI').

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S27

Survey copy as specified: baseline questions and options, Settings feedback text (T6 only)

Tickets: TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Local QA stack only (round-companion-wt-qa at main 43c38a4f, the build dev runs); brand-new @roundai.test accounts; survey, usage and patient-activity rows read with the local admin key; no model call from these specs (the Convex socket answers generateHandoff in the browser and refuses every other ai/* action; tripwire: no Generate). Read only (the baseline survey opened and closed with 'Later', nothing answered or sent; the 4 PM card read with the browser clock at 16:30 yesterday on an account whose baseline was answered over the API). Judged string by string against TFA-94609 Spec 1 / Spec 3 (typographic apostrophes and the en dash compared as the same characters): 15 of 18 checks pass — the six baseline questions except the product name, the open number field, the buckets Under 5 / 5–10 / 10–15 / 15–20 / Over 20 min for both duration questions, Paper list / EMR list / Notes on my phone / Other, Never / Sometimes / Most days / Every day, the free text marked (optional); in Settings and on the 4 PM card 'Your answers go to the pilot team.', 'Please don't include patient details.', a 1-5 rating, 'What should change?' and 'Send feedback'. Failed (3): the product name — the app says 'Before Round Companion, how long did preparing for each patient take (chart review, pre-rounding)?' and 'How is Round Companion working for you?' (Settings and the 4 PM card) where the ticket says 'RoundAI' (decision D12, Daniela; known). The handoff follow-up copy (Spec 2) passes in S07; the task-reminder copy (Spec 4) passes in S14 C (its free text works as optional but is not marked '(optional)' like the baseline's: recorded).

Product issue: The baseline survey and the general feedback (in Settings and on the new 4 PM card) call the product 'Round Companion' ('Before Round Companion, how long did preparing…', 'How is Round Companion working for you?') where the ticket's copy says 'RoundAI'. Everything else in the surveys reads as specified. Which name to use is Daniela's decision D12.

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: ticket-gate — ticket-gate: TFA-94609 ready for pr — requirements T6 gated (runnable on dev otherwise). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local code-review] known gap (code-review/results.json) — code-review: known-gap → known gap (known gap) Spec 1 / Spec 3 strings searched in apps/web/src at e02167f: 12/12 present; present with a difference: B2 ('RoundAI' reads 'Round Companion' (knownGap: open Q11)), F1 ('RoundAI' reads 'Round Companion' (knownGap: open Q11); straight apostrophe is a typographic ’ in the app (same words)). T6 is gated on TFA-94609 (ready for pr, PR #86): a miss reports…
